text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh, not this one, and not that one 
either...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Guess what? Right now, I'm 
mixing my very own original blend of 
spices!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It just needs one more twist, but... I 
just can't seem to find the decisive 
factor! Even though I've been thinking 
about it non-stop~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ghh—! What could it be, what could it be~! 
What is it I'm missing~! I can't calm down 
until I find it~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono is so absorbed in blending 
spices that she can't seem to focus on 
anything else...
